summary: Authored connectors must keep their full painted arrowhead bounds at least 12px from text; multiline labels allow layout-only patching.
invariants: Measure connector clearance from painted arrowhead bounds, including rotation.
Keep at least 12px between connector paint and text glyphs.
Multiline text boxes with only hard breaks allow style, position, and size patches but not text replacement.
forbidden: Do not treat the unrotated CSS arrowhead box as the clearance boundary.
Do not overlap connector paint with visible text.
